items.title: The henselian property of a pair depends only on the radical of the ideal
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that whether a pair is henselian depends only on the radical of the ideal: ideals with the same vanishing locus give henselian pairs simultaneously. The proof uses the criterion for the henselian property through bijectivity on idempotents: for an integral algebra the two ideals generate the same closed set, so the idempotents of the two quotients are in bijective correspondence, and hence one quotient map induces a bijection on idempotents exactly when the other does. The criterion then applies.
